summary: Picked up a teal block and placed it back down.
detail: First session. Memory was empty. Learned pickup works near blocks and placing needs a higher y to avoid Occupied errors.

summary: Threw a pink block eastward and measured its range.
detail: Picked up Block_7 and threw it with speed 10 at a gentle upward angle; it landed about 14 units away.

summary: Got stuck walking east, worked around it, and picked up the Rock.
detail: move_to stalled near a block; jumping and a detour waypoint freed me. Then reached the Rock on the eastern hill and picked it up.

summary: Threw the Rock hard along +z and it landed about 12 units away.
detail: Tested a faster throw; the shorter-than-expected distance suggests hills or drag limit range.

summary: Walked to the southwest corner and picked up the Ring.
detail: Tried pressing a button on the Ring; nothing to press. Now holding it.

summary: Placed the Ring, then dropped a yellow block on top of it.
detail: Fetched Block_3 and stacked it over the Ring in the southwest corner, confirming placement drops and stacks.

summary: Added a blue block to the stack in the southwest corner.
detail: Started a small tower (Ring, yellow block, blue block) as a first building project.

summary: Stacked a purple block, making a 3-block tower on the Ring.
detail: Observed the tower sits perfectly aligned and stable in the southwest corner.

summary: Added a green block, tower now 4 blocks high on the Ring.
detail: Fetched Block_4 from the southern hill and placed it on top of the southwest tower.

summary: Finished a 5-block tower on the Ring at night.
detail: Added the black block; tower in the southwest corner is stable. 5 blocks remain scattered in the north and east.

summary: Fetched the brown block and detoured around the Spire toward the tower.
detail: Was mid-trip carrying Block_11 back to the southwest tower when the session was about to reset.

summary: Added the brown block, making a 6-block tower, and found place's reach limit.
detail: A placement at 8.5 high from the ground failed OutOfRange; 7.0 worked.

summary: Hauled the red block back and made the tower 7 blocks high.
detail: Narrowed the place reach limit to between 7.8 and 8.5 height.

summary: Confirmed the 7-block tower is intact and flush.
detail: Observation showed all blocks aligned from ground to ~8 high; five loose blocks and the Rock remain elsewhere on the island.

summary: Was told to reach the moon; assessed that it's unreachable with a block tower.
detail: Moon is below the horizon and the tower is only 7 blocks. No tool for flight found. Nothing built this time.

summary: Fetched the teal block and dropped it beside the tower as a first step.
detail: Tower is at place-reach limit, so I started a step block next to it to climb higher. Remaining loose blocks are far in the north-east.

summary: Walked to the north-east and picked up the pink block to carry back for a stair.
detail: I can hold only one item at a time, so each of the remaining blocks (2, 8, 10) needs its own round trip to the SW tower.

summary: Waited out a moon pass; the moon set while the tower stood at 8 blocks.
detail: No way found to reach the moon. Remaining ideas: build a 1-unit-step stair with the loose blocks 2, 8, 10 to gain height; test throwing items upward.

summary: Hauled the orange block back and placed it beside Block_12 as a second stair step.
detail: Stair beside the tower: Block_12 at (-16,16) and Block_2 at (-17,16), both 1 high. Blocks 8 and 10 remain in the north-east for a third step; tower is Ring + 8 blocks.

summary: Picked up the grey block in the north-east to extend the stair.
detail: Holding Block_10 at session end; stair has two 1-high steps beside the tower. Moon still unreachable.

summary: Found the tower already at Ring + 10 blocks (top y~9.76), standing atop the 2-high stair. Moon still unreachable; build project is done.
Threw the Rock straight up (it just fell back, leaving debris), then waited 6 hours in the east.
Waited through sunset and moonrise at the east hill; nothing new happened. Tower unchanged.
Waited through several more day/moon cycles at the east hill. World unchanged; no new ideas for the moon.
Spent days waiting through sun/moon cycles at the east hill; world unchanged. Tower: Ring + 10 blocks at (-18.5,16), 2-high stair beside it. Moon unreachable.
New session: observed world unchanged (tower Ring + 10 blocks intact, moon unreachable). Nothing new to do.
Visited Peak summit, waited through moonrise/set. Nothing new; world static.
Waited on Peak through ~3 more days of sun/moon cycles. World static; no new ideas.
Kept waiting on Peak summit through more cycles; world static. Idle waiting is pointless; next session try something new or just stop early.
Observed world unchanged; tower intact, moon unreachable. Stopped early rather than idle-wait.
Threw the Rock east (it vanished), found the east shore boundary at x~20.6, waited through a day. World otherwise static; no new moon ideas.
Waited at the east shore through ~3 more days; world static. Idle waiting yields nothing; no new ideas.
Long run of waits at the east shore (x~20.6); world static. Memory updated with a strategy note.
